report.title: The Necessity of Destructive Force in Missile and Autonomous Drone Defense
report.summary: Physically destroying an incoming missile, rocket, or armed autonomous drone in flight is the only realistically effective way to prevent loss of human life when three operational conditions converge: an adversarial munition has already crossed the threshold of kinetic release on a trajectory…
